title: The World Bank cut 93 of 146 forecasts. India's went up.

metadata.caveat: These are individual economies. The GEP's regional tables also carry 26 sub-aggregates (GCC, Central Asia, SAR excluding India and so on) that double count their own members; counting those too gives 114 cut of 172. India reports on an April-March fiscal year, so its 2026 column is FY2026/27 while most others are calendar-year. Most other upgrades are commodity exporters or very small economies, but 14 commodity importers were upgraded too, the largest Jamaica at +1.3.
